                              Backup and data

                              Station profiles

                              Saved with "Save as station profile" in a station's details; offered first when checking a station in. Sessions keep their own copy.

                                Back up and restore

                                Downloads every series, session, station and note as one file.

                                Loads a backup file. Nothing stored here is overwritten; clashing sessions come in as copies.

                                A backup is a plain JSON file: anyone with the file can read it. Deleting something here does not delete copies already exported.

                                Callsign lists

                                Your own lists (a text file in the PoLo format, or CSV) and the Austrian list apply to all tools on this device together: Confirm, Notfunk and Netlog.

                                Station lookup links

                                Netlog only offers links to QRZ.com, HamQTH, QRZCQ, APRS.fi and – if set on the Wavelog import page – your Wavelog; they need internet and are opened only by you. Nothing is looked up or sent by itself.

                                Danger zone

                                Deleting a session, station or note is reversible (restore, undo). Erasing removes it from this device for good, with its history and drafts.

                                ⬇

                                Work without a server

                                Netlog as one HTML file with the callsign and repeater lists, about 1 MB, for a USB stick or laptop: runs without a server and without internet. Its data is stored by the browser for that file, separately from this installed version; move data between them with a backup (JSON).

                                Search

                                  Offline: only what is stored on this device. ↓/↑ move, Enter opens the match, Esc closes.

                                  Move notes

                                  Same station?

                                    Merging keeps every note, time and response; Undo separates them again. Nothing is merged without this confirmation.
